subject.title: fix(feishu): accumulate streamed final delta chunks (#91562)

question: Should maintainers require live Feishu/CardKit proof after a helper repair and rebase, or apply a proof override after sanctioned verification?
rationale: The external contributor cannot provide a live Feishu tenant capture, and ClawSweeper cannot treat helper terminal output plus mocked tests as sufficient real behavior proof for a user-visible channel delivery change.

options.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
options.body: Tighten the helper, rebase onto current main, and require either redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or a maintainer-run proof override before merge.

options.title: Override After Verification
options.body: A maintainer with Feishu access can explicitly own the proof gap after verifying the repaired branch in a sanctioned setup.

options.title: Fold Into Broad Tracker
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers want the latest-token fix handled together with the broader Feishu streaming-card reliability work.

recommendation.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
recommendation.body: Tighten the helper, rebase onto current main, and require either redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or a maintainer-run proof override before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the live assignee and have recent current-main ownership signal on the affected Feishu files.
